title: LINZ natural-colour North Island terrain and bathymetry artwork (2013 archive)
credit: Crown copyright 2013, Land Information New Zealand and the New Zealand Government
altText: Natural-colour terrain rendering of northern New Zealand showing forests, landforms, coastline and blue shaded bathymetric sea floor.
caption: LINZ's archived natural-colour terrain and bathymetry artwork distributed with its 2013 basemap source files. The image represents the LINZ publication workflow rather than Geographx's separate commercially licensed 4 m basemap.
context: Exact original file and Git blob SHA preserved from the LINZ source repository, distributed under the 2013 project's CC BY 3.0 NZ statement.
